scope: Research only, reused previously retrieved recordings and cached frames; no downloads, paid APIs, production modifications or new dictionary registrations.

method.layout: Two fixed 1920x1080 Japanese ranked doubles layouts fitted on cached preview frames; binary bright-title mask NCC >= .75 and minimum red border occupancy >= .90 across six panels, reject if zero or multiple layout matches.
method.dedup: Two consecutive positive samples with slot appearance consistency start provisional episode. Anchor signature six 24x24 normalized BGR crops; all slot mean absolute distances <= .30; break if dissimilar or gap > 5 seconds. No inferred battle identity.

execution: Initial combined scan timed out after first segment printed; separate scans completed and first-segment counts reproduced. Full per-sample results retained locally, not published; no raw frames, glyph template, names or lineups committed.
limitations: One apparent battle; cached positive and negative frames used in method development; segment 4 shares same source recording. No exhaustive per-sampled-frame ground truth; no recall or general accuracy claim. 149 positives contiguous, so actual real short-gap bridging not demonstrated; synthetic tests only.

Fixed resolution, two layout offsets, Japanese UI title, local calibration frame dependency; no arbitrary localization or resolution support. Thresholds exploratory; red background can dominate appearance signature. No tested distinct similar teams or rapid rematches; never use provisional episode ID as battle ID.

No cross-file merging, no VFR exact timing, no complete decode-end versus decode-error distinction. No image generation, label confirmation or PV09 integration in PV11. Existing detector imported but not used by new fixed-layout gate; could remove unnecessary import in later revision.
